proof: This task does not change pending-signal deduplication; CurrentArtifactStrategy emits a binding-scoped monotonically sequenced decision identifier into the existing validated queue path.
Missing artifact checksum produces artifact_unavailable, leaves queue depth zero, and records the binding in degraded_bindings.
Missing market input produces market_input_missing, leaves queue depth zero, and records the binding in degraded_bindings.
The normal runner health file reports degraded, enqueued_signal_count=0, and the exact degraded binding when artifact truth is unavailable.
The decision retains binding, runtime, pool, artifact, tenant, environment, run, and trade-journey correlation identities.
The approved-artifact acceptance drains the binding-scoped signal into PaperRuntimeService and reads back heartbeat, order_submitted, and paper_fill_simulated events.

Each producer process reconstructs CurrentArtifactStrategy and re-evaluates exact artifact and market-input availability on its next binding tick; unavailable durable inputs remain degraded with zero enqueue and no hardcoded fallback.
Operational rollback is to pause the paper producer; no fixed BUY/SELL strategy is restored as the normal runner.
Missing or contradicted decision inputs compensate by emitting zero signals and preserving explicit degraded truth.

environment_boundary.proof: CurrentArtifactStrategy requires paper mode; canary/live activation and shared deployment configuration are outside this change.
